page.newDescription: Runs as a container with a persistent volume on the aoox network; applications in this project can reach it through the internal host name.

variants.noneDescription: Standard postgres image, no extra extensions.
variants.pgvector: Vector similarity search for embeddings (AI/ML workloads).
variants.postgis: Geographic/spatial data types, indexes and queries.

form.hostPortHint: Publish a host port only if the database must be reachable from outside (e.g. from your laptop).

toast.created: Database "{name}" created. It is being set up (pulling the image can take a few minutes).

internal.title: Internal connection
internal.description: From applications in this project (aoox network). Paste into the application env, e.g. DATABASE_URL.

external.title: External connection
external.notPublished: Not published; only reachable from the aoox network.
external.recreateHint: Recreate the database with a host port if you need access from outside.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: The container is stopped and removed. Choose whether the data (volume) is deleted too. This cannot be undone.

add.title: Add database
add.description: Creates another database on this server. Host, user and password stay the same; only the database name in the connection URL differs.

drop.title: Delete database {name}?
drop.description: Database {name} and all its tables and data are deleted permanently and this cannot be undone. Applications still using it will fail to connect.

resources.title: Resource limits
resources.description: Empty = no limit. Raising or lowering a limit applies immediately; removing a limit recreates the container (brief restart, data stays safe in the volume).

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Dumps are stored in the aoox_backups volume on this server. Restore overwrites existing data.
backups.descriptionWithDestination: Dumps are stored in the aoox_backups volume on this server and copied to {destination}. Restore overwrites existing data.

schedule.title: Backup schedule & destination
schedule.description: Old scheduled backups are deleted automatically beyond the number kept (also from S3). S3 destinations are added in Settings.

restoreDialog.title: Restore backup?
restoreDialog.description: The current data of {name} will be overwritten with the contents of {file}. This cannot be undone; create a backup first if unsure.

companion.title: Admin UI
companion.description: A web interface for managing this database, running in a separate container.
companion.empty: No Admin UI yet. Install it with one click, then open it from a domain or an IP and port.
companion.developerOnly: Only developers and above can install an Admin UI.
companion.databaseLoginHint: Sign in with the database username and password (see the Internal connection card, Show password button).

toast.installed: The Admin UI is being set up; pulling the image can take a few minutes

removeDialog.title: Remove Admin UI?
removeDialog.description: The {tool} container is stopped and removed. Database data is not affected.

installDialog.title: Install Admin UI
installDialog.description: Choose a tool and how to open it.
installDialog.noteDatabaseLogin: Sign in with the database login

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Through the reverse proxy with its own hostname.

port.title: IP & port
port.description: Published on a host port of this server.

installDialog.domainHint: The reverse proxy must be running and the hostname's DNS must point to this server's IP.

browser.notRunning: The database must be running to browse its data.

deleteRow.title: Delete this row?
deleteRow.description: Row {pk} will be permanently deleted from {table}. This cannot be undone.
deleteRow.descriptionFallback: The row will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Run {name}?
import.description: The file {name} ({size} KB) will be run on database {db}. Its statements are executed as-is, including any that change or delete data.

query.hintKv: One command, e.g. HGETALL user:1 or SCAN 0 MATCH sess:* COUNT 100.
query.hintMongo: One query, e.g. users.find('{'"age":'{'"$gt":18'}''}'). Only find(), read-only for now.
query.hintSql: One statement per run; SELECT without LIMIT is capped at 500 rows, 15 second timeout.
query.writeHint: You can write (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL). Be careful, there is no undo.
query.readOnlyHint: This session is read-only; only owners and admins can change data.
query.summary: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {ms} ms

rowEdit.title: Edit row
rowEdit.description: {table}: located by its primary key ({keys}); those columns cannot be changed here.
rowEdit.missingPk: The value of column "{name}" was not found in this row

createTable.title: Create table
createTable.description: Basic columns only; indexes, foreign keys and special types can be added from the SQL box once the table exists.

errors.invalidTable: Invalid table name (letters, digits and _ only)
